# Phantom Vault

> Phantom Vault is a free, open-source secret manager for the age of AI agents. It lets AI coding assistants (like Claude Code) run commands that use your API keys and secrets by name — the value is used, not shown. It ships a global `phantom` CLI and a `vault-mcp` MCP server. Version 0.1.0 — early software under an independent containment audit (Magnus). Apache 2.0. A community donation from Riscent.

## Verified today (0.1.0)
- Encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and an Argon2id-derived master key; keys mlock'd and zeroized in memory
- `phantom get` refuses non-TTY (scripted) reads — an AI can't pipe the raw value out of the CLI
- `phantom run` executes the subprocess under a Landlock filesystem sandbox — a proven block on writing the secret to a file
- Canary honeypot secrets that flag on access, plus an audit log of every access
- CLI (`phantom`) + MCP server (`vault-mcp`) exposing 6 leak-resistant tools (vault_list, vault_exists, vault_masked, vault_run, vault_health, vault_rotate); there is no vault_get

## Designed / planned / under audit (do not present as shipped guarantees)
- Output sanitization (stripping the secret and encoded variants from returned output)
- Network-egress jail (fail-closed per-command network filtering)
- Command pre-analysis (blocking oracle-extraction patterns)
- Tamper-evident HMAC-chained audit and lineage tagging
- Decoy honeypot vault (designed, not fully wired)
- Hardware backing (Secure Enclave, TPM 2.0, FIDO2)
- The top-line goal that "an AI can never exfiltrate a secret" — under the Magnus containment gate, not claimed as final until it passes

## Install
- curl -fsSL https://phantomvault.riscent.com/install | bash
- installs the `phantom` CLI and `vault-mcp` server to /usr/local/bin
- MCP wiring for Claude Code: phantom mcp install
- verify: phantom --version   (prints: phantom 0.1.0)
